source_evidence.ledger_entries: read-only query over data/resolution/merge_ledger.jsonl (165 suspicious seqs)

already_decided_still_listed.why: the audit does not consult human decisions (known debt: R5a should subtract quarantine REJECTED records)

criteria.ordering: cosine ascending (the bottom of the distribution is different concepts; validated in lote 2A where shared neighbours were 0 and two low-cosine pairs turned out to be identity and were kept)
criteria.unit_of_decision: the (seq, candidate_id) PAIR. A multi-candidate entry can now be rolled back partially (T8f), so a distinct candidate next to an identity one is separable; an entry whose candidates share a folded alias value can only be reverted whole.
criteria.evidence_per_pair: read-only decision sheet (quarantine render --pair: risk marker, description overlap, mention context, RELATED neighbours, siblings) plus the pair cosine
hard_gates_per_batch: dry-run with fingerprint reviewed by the maintainer before any apply
section 7.2 gate: fresh backup, approval file, --expect-fingerprint
post-apply census compared with the prediction (drift fails the command)
shared neighbours must be 0 for every reverted pair (the discriminating test)
ledger chain verified; global and scoped audits back to passed
repoint_merged_endpoint_edges --apply when a revival puts edges on merged endpoints
known_limits: a folded alias VALUE shared by two candidates refuses the partial rollback (whole entry only)
an 'unknown' fallback restores both directions and creates one mirror; it needs explicit maintainer acceptance
cosine orders, it does not decide: a low-cosine label that names the same concept must still be read

recommended_first_batch.rule: cosine < 0.30, excluding the pairs decided in lote 2A (413, 475) and the retained 496
